get.description: Counts earthquakes matching a USGS Earthquake Hazards query.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Only count events on or after this ISO8601 UTC time.

get.description: Finds earthquakes in USGS Earthquake Hazards by search parameters.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: Only return events on or after this ISO8601 UTC time.

schema.description: Only return events on or after this ISO8601 UTC time.

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: Only return events on or before this ISO8601 UTC time.

schema.description: Only return events on or before this ISO8601 UTC time.

parameters.name: minmagnitude
parameters.description: Only return events with magnitude greater than or equal to this value.

schema.description: Only return events with magnitude greater than or equal to this value.

parameters.name: maxmagnitude
parameters.description: Only return events with magnitude less than or equal to this value.

schema.description: Only return events with magnitude less than or equal to this value.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude for radius search. Use with longitude and maximum radius in kilometers.

schema.description: Latitude for radius search. Use with longitude and maximum radius in kilometers.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude for radius search. Use with latitude and maximum radius in kilometers.

schema.description: Longitude for radius search. Use with latitude and maximum radius in kilometers.

parameters.name: maxradiuskm
parameters.description: Maximum distance in kilometers from the latitude and longitude point.

schema.description: Maximum distance in kilometers from the latitude and longitude point.

parameters.name: eventtype
parameters.description: Limit results to a USGS event type such as earthquake.

schema.description: Limit results to a USGS event type such as earthquake.

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: USGS event ordering mode.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return.

schema.description: Maximum number of events to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: One-based result offset for USGS catalog pagination.

schema.description: One-based result offset for USGS catalog pagination.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An RSQL expression used to filter the results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Fields to sort by, with an optional direction for each field.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

bbox.description: Bounding box for returned event features.

metadata.description: USGS feed metadata including generated time, URL, title, status, API version, and count.
